description: Reproducibility Package for Eligibility-Gated Graph-Hydraulic Prescreening of Single-Pipe Outages in Synthetic Irrigation Distribution Networks — V8.6 Direct EPANET 2.2 Confirmation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors MOHAMED ABDELBARY. This reproducibility package supports the manuscript “Eligibility-Gated Graph-Hydraulic Prescreening of Single-Pipe Outages in Synthetic Irrigation Distribution Networks.” It contains the frozen V8.5 decision rule, deterministic network-generation and hydraulic-analysis code, fresh confirmation datasets, closure-level results, topology-family and failure-mode analyses, sensitivity and stress tests, scalability evidence, WaterGEMS cross-checks, and 90 frozen EPANET input files. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
